@@info: Prefer translating in your browser? Fink edits messages/uk.json directly — no code or git:
This file is the offline alternative.
Keys that exist in <en> but not in <uk>.
The values below are the en source text — replace them with uk translations.
You do not have to translate all of them; leave out what you are unsure about and open a PR.
A maintainer then runs 'npm run i18n:apply' to merge this file into messages/uk.json.
Anything still missing afterwards simply renders in en at runtime.
Plurals — uk uses the forms: one, few, many, other. "other" is required.
(add "plural": "total" to count another input instead of {count}).
Inside a sentence, # is the number: "Read {count, plural, one {# band} other {# bands}}"
An exact number like "=0": "No bands" beats the forms above.
device_peq_status_saved_reconnecting: Saved. The device restarts after saving; reconnecting…
device_peq_status_saved_reconnected: Wrote {count} band(s). The device restarted to save and is connected again.
device_control_eq_off: The device doesn't apply its EQ with this {control} setting.
device_control_eq_off_hint: The device doesn't apply its EQ with this setting.
device_control_confirm_body: The device restarts to apply it, and the sound stops for a moment. uniPEQ connects to it again.
device_control_restarted: Changed {control}. The device restarted and is connected again.
device_control_restart_reconnect: Changed {control}. The device restarted; reconnect to carry on.
device_control_restart_choose: Changed {control}. The device restarted; reconnect, and pick it again if the browser asks.
settings_database_never_checked: Never; using the copy built into the app
eq_builtin: This is one of {device}'s built-in presets, so it can't be edited. Pick a user preset to change its bands.
